body:
## Motivation

Add AMD MI355X DI/CI nightly recipes for **GLM-5.2 (MXFP4)** 2-node 1P1D
disaggregation, so the nightly exercises the GLM MoE line the same way it already
covers DeepSeek-V4 and Kimi-K2.6. Scope is the **basic tier** (TP8 1P1D, base +
MTP + DP8/EP8); wide-EP16 is deferred to a follow-up.

GLM-5.2 uses `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM` (DeepSeek Sparse Attention; sglang
auto-selects the DSA attention backend) with a **built-in NextN MTP head**
(`num_nextn_predict_layers=1`) — the same MTP mechanism as DeepSeek-V4, so no
external draft checkpoint is needed.

## What's new

4 new recipes under `scripts/ci/slurm/recipes/mi355x-fp4/glm52/1k1k/`:

| Recipe | Topology | MTP |
|---|---|---|
| `1p1d.yaml` | TP8 1P1D | no |
| `1p1d-mtp.yaml` | TP8 1P1D | NextN |
| `1p1d-dp8ep8.yaml` | DP-attn 8 + EP8 1P1D | no |
| `1p1d-dp8ep8-mtp.yaml` | DP-attn 8 + EP8 1P1D | NextN |

Plus 4 matching blocks in `scripts/ci/slurm/nightly-configs.yaml`
(`glm52-fp4-mi355x[-mtp|-dp8ep8|-dp8ep8-mtp]-sglang`).

Each recipe carries a `model:` block so the launcher takes the **generic**
command-build path (not the hardcoded DeepSeek-V4 branch): it sets the GLM
reasoning/tool parsers (`glm45`) and `--disable-shared-experts-fusion`
(GLM has `n_shared_experts=1`), and leaves `attention_backend` unset so the
server auto-selects DSA for `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM`.

## Runtime image

Recipes reference **`lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.15.post1-rocm720-mi35x-20260722`**.
This image includes **#30265** ("[AMD] Fix GLM-5.2 MTP Quark excludes"), which adds
the dedicated `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLMNextN` class + GLM-specific Quark excludes /
MTP layer-index remap. That fix is required for GLM NextN MTP accuracy — an
earlier image predating #30265 ran GLM MTP through the raw non-DSA V3 NextN and
dropped GSM8K to ~0.87.

## Validation (MI355X, 2-node 1P1D, GSM8K full 1319Q 8-shot, gate 0.91)

| Leg | Accuracy | Invalid | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `1p1d.yaml` (base) | **0.930** | 0.001 | ✅ PASS |
| `1p1d-mtp.yaml` (NextN) | **0.933** | 0.000 | ✅ PASS |
| `1p1d-dp8ep8.yaml` | **0.945** | 0.000 | ✅ PASS |
| `1p1d-dp8ep8-mtp.yaml` | — | — | ❌ CRASH (see below) |

Three of the four legs pass cleanly on 20260722. **`1p1d-dp8ep8-mtp` crashes at
runtime** — it is kept in this draft but must not be treated as passing.

### dp8ep8-mtp crash

`RuntimeError: Expected lengths.size(0) == B to be true, but got false` in the DSA
sparse-attention top-k indexer during the NextN draft forward, only when
DP-attention and MTP are combined:

```
deepseek_nextn.py:276 forward
  -> deepseek_v2.py:1860 forward -> forward_absorb_prepare (forward_mla.py:384)
    -> dsa_indexer.py:1998 forward_cuda -> _get_topk_paged (dsa_indexer.py:1038)
      -> dsa_backend.py:315 topk_transform -> dsa_topk_backend.py:130
        -> sgl_kernel/top_k.py:77 fast_topk_transform_fused  (assert lengths.size(0)==B)
```

Each ingredient works alone on this image (dp8ep8 without MTP = 0.945; MTP without
DP-attention = 0.933); only the dp8+MTP combination breaks the DSA topk `lengths`
tensor (per-batch seqlens not built for the DP-padded NextN draft-extend batch).
This is a source-level bug in DSA + NextN + DP-attention, not a recipe knob, and is
out of scope for this recipe PR — tracked separately.

## Non-regression

Adds only new files + new nightly blocks. No existing recipe, launcher line, or
nightly block is modified — existing legs stay byte-identical.

## Notes / caveats

- **Checkpoint on disk is `amd/GLM-5.1-MXFP4`** (the only GLM MXFP4 build currently
  mirrored on `/it-share`). The recipe/block naming tracks the GLM-5.2 model line;
  `model_path` points at the mirrored 5.1 MXFP4 checkpoint. Retarget `model_path`
  when the 5.2 checkpoint lands.

## Checklist
- [ ] Format with pre-commit
- [x] Validate base on MI355X (GSM8K 0.930 >= 0.91)
- [x] Validate MTP on MI355X (GSM8K 0.933 >= 0.91)
- [x] Validate DP8/EP8 on MI355X (GSM8K 0.945 >= 0.91)
- [ ] Fix dp8ep8-mtp DSA+NextN+DP-attn crash (source-level, tracked separately)

commits.messageBody:
…image

Two corrections so the GLM-5.2 recipes actually start under launch_mi355x.sh:

1. Add a model: block (env + server_args) to all 4 recipes. Its presence
   routes the launcher onto the generic command-build path instead of the
   hardcoded DeepSeek-V4 branch, which unconditionally emits
   --attention-backend $ATTN. GLM leaves attention unset (DSA is
   auto-selected for GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM), so the DSV4 branch failed with
   "argument --attention-backend: expected one argument". The generic path
   only emits the flag when non-empty, and carries the GLM reasoning/tool
   parsers (glm45) + --disable-shared-experts-fusion.

2. Switch image 20260715 -> 20260623. 20260715 fails at server start
   JIT-compiling the shared DeepSeek-V4 grouped-topk kernel
   (cooperative_groups.h missing on gfx950); 20260623 ships it prebuilt and
   still supports GlmMoeDsa + DSA + glm45 parser.

Validated on 2-node 1P1D MI355X (TP8): base GSM8K 0.928 (gate 0.91).
